content.title: OT-E (Olde Town East) District
content.summary: The Olde Town-East zoning district in Arvada is designed to preserve the historic character of the area while allowing a mix of residential, commercial, and community uses. Various classifications, such as townhomes, multifamily units, hotels, and medical offices, are permitted by-right or with limitations, as outlined in the city's Land Development Code. Specific regulations govern the use of properties within this district to ensure compliance with the established design guidelines.
content.body:
The intent of the Olde Town form-based zoning districts is to protect the established historic character of Olde Town Arvada based on the City's adopted plans and design guidelines for the area. The Olde Town-East zoning district is a mixed use zone district allowing all building form types.

Acronyms:

- Allowed Use By-Right (A)
- Limited Use (L)
- Conditional Use (C)

**Note**: If a use is not listed in the table then it is not allowed in the zoning district

| Boarding, Lodging, or Rooming House | A | N/A |
| Group Home, FFHA | L | 3-1-3-3 |
| Group Home, Not Specified Above | C | 3-1-3-3 |
